program: Program E — Quality Gate Root Cause Isolation

investigation_artifacts.note: Local report shows 'passed' but was generated from a previous run with cached changed_files from commit 22ed278d. The current HEAD (08fdea46) has a different changed file set.

_merge_scopes() correctly limits QUICK to [QUICK]. _collect_requirements() filters by allowed scopes. Planner selects 1 target (quick-run) and 1 step (run_fast_checks.sh).
Runs ruff, black, mypy, pytest tests/unit/, tests/architecture/, tests/meta/. Uses 'set -euo pipefail' but failures inside 'if' blocks are caught and recorded in FAILED_CHECKS.
Registers pytest_plugins = ['tests.fixtures.database', ...]. Loading this plugin triggers ImportError when src.core.db.schema is missing.
Line 24: 'from src.core.db.schema import create_all, run_migrations, verify_schema'. This import fails in CI because schema.py is not in git.
Also imports 'from src.core.db.schema import ...'. This file exists in git but depends on schema.py which is missing.
Line 89: 'src/' — this pattern matches 'backend/src/' at any level, causing the entire backend/src/core/db/ package to be ignored by git.

evidence_summary: The developer workstation has backend/src/core/db/schema.py and related files present on disk, but these files were never committed to git. The .gitignore rule 'src/' (line 89) causes git to ignore backend/src/core/db/. In CI, the clean checkout lacks these files, causing pytest to fail when loading tests.fixtures.database plugin.
